scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Camila Perez and I'm 66. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I can look at that. What is your account number?
I see the charge here. It says 'Global Retail Services'. Do you have any idea what that is? I need to know if you recognize it before I can do anything.
No, I've never heard of that company. I'm quite sure I didn't buy anything from them.

You said your name was Camila Perez, right? I'm just going to go ahead and escalate this to the fraud department because I don't want to deal with the paperwork for a dispute right now. They will handle the refund if they find it's unauthorized.
Oh, okay. How long will that take? I'm a bit worried about the money being gone.
I don't know, they'll contact you eventually. Is there anything else?

escalation_reason: Agent bypassed standard dispute resolution procedures and offloaded the request to the fraud department due to personal unwillingness to process the claim.
